g2-nub-ruffini-land.notes: Old Nubian sales including third-party transfers and earlier editions of Gerald Browne; abstract does not establish broad population rates.

g2-nub-ruffini-mash.title: Giovanni R. Ruffini, Mashshouda and Archive 3 (Oxford, 2012)
g2-nub-ruffini-mash.notes: Prosopographical reinterpretation of a named Qasr Ibrim archive; Mashshouda’s title remains uncertain.

g2-nub-ruffini-conc.title: Giovanni R. Ruffini, Conclusion: Medieval Nubian Society and Gender (Oxford, 2012)
g2-nub-ruffini-conc.notes: Highlights women’s land ownership, royal succession and the limits of archive extrapolation; publicly available abstract rather than full chapter.

g2-nub-ruffini-ceremony.title: Giovanni R. Ruffini, Nubian Land Sales as Ceremony (Oxford, 2012)
g2-nub-ruffini-ceremony.notes: Interpretation of witnesses and food/drink in legal transactions; ceremonial meaning is a scholarly hypothesis.

g2-nub-ruffini-money.title: Giovanni R. Ruffini, Money, Rent, Taxes, and Investment (Oxford, 2012)
g2-nub-ruffini-money.notes: Reconstruction of monetary ratios and rents from specific archives; not a full Nubian economic census.

g2-nub-khan.title: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Documents from Medieval Nubia (Open Book Publishers, 2024)
g2-nub-khan.notes: Edition and translations of Qasr Ibrim Arabic corpus; manuscripts preserve formal legal and administrative perspectives rather than unconstrained inner voices.

g2-nub-khan-legal.title: Geoffrey Khan, Legal Documents, Arabic Documents from Medieval Nubia (2024)
g2-nub-khan-legal.notes: Identifies numbered leases, land transactions, marriage, divorce and judges’ correspondence; legal forms must be read critically.

g2-nub-khan-eparchs.title: Geoffrey Khan, Correspondence with Eparchs, Arabic Documents from Medieval Nubia (2024)
g2-nub-khan-eparchs.notes: Letters between Muslim merchants and Nubian officials and exchange including enslaved people; archive is selective.

g2-nub-maryam50.title: Princeton Geniza Project, Qasr Ibrim document 50, translation by Geoffrey Khan
g2-nub-maryam50.notes: A dated formal divorce acknowledgement concerning Maryam; the legal document is not her firsthand interior testimony.

g2-nub-maryam53.title: Princeton Geniza Project, Qasr Ibrim document 53, edited and translated by Geoffrey Khan
g2-nub-maryam53.notes: Letter concerning Maryam and competing marital claims; reflects a judicial perspective and missing context.

g2-sw-unesco.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Ruins of Kilwa Kisiwani and Songo Mnara
g2-sw-unesco.notes: Site locations, date ranges, mosques, coral houses and maritime connections; heritage description not a census of household activity.

g2-sw-york.title: University of York, Stephanie Wynne-Jones research profile and Songo Mnara project
g2-sw-york.notes: Methods and site focus of household and open-space research; institutional summary, not full specialist dataset.

g2-sw-walshaw.title: Sarah Walshaw, Cooking and Crafting at Songo Mnara: Macrobotanical Remains (2015)
g2-sw-walshaw.notes: Published abstract on plant remains from stone and earthen buildings; abstract excerpt reviewed, not detailed sample distributions.

g2-sw-public.title: Jeffrey Fleisher and Federica Sulas, Deciphering Public Spaces at Songo Mnara (Journal of Archaeological Science, 2015)
g2-sw-public.notes: Spatial method synthesis and conclusions about open spaces; abstract only, no claim to precise identities.

g2-sw-coins.title: John Perkins, Jeffrey Fleisher and Stephanie Wynne-Jones, A Deposit of Kilwa-Type Coins from Songo Mnara (Azania, 2014)
g2-sw-coins.notes: Well-contextualized coin deposit from a stonehouse foundation; interpretation as investing value in place is tentative.

g2-bag-unesco.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Bagan
g2-bag-unesco.notes: 11th–13th-century monument landscape, endowment politics, Ayeyarwady, continuing communities and practices; not household legal archive.

g2-bag-myazedi.title: UNESCO Memory of the World, Myazedi Quadrilingual Stone Inscription
g2-bag-myazedi.notes: Four script/language faces, Bagan setting, dating to 1113; monument’s multilingual text is not a census.

g2-bag-field.title: IRAW@Bagan 2018 field season report: residential patterning, agricultural practices and water management
g2-bag-field.notes: Research report discusses inscriptions and nonmonumental landscapes; web excerpt reviewed, and later chronicles distinguished from contemporary evidence.

g2-bag-architecture.title: Religious Symbols as Decorations on the Sikhara of Ancient Monuments in the Late Bagan Period (Bagan and the World, 2018)
g2-bag-architecture.notes: 13th-century monuments, decorative styles and inscription dating; chapter abstract only.

g2-java-boro.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Borobudur Temple Compounds
g2-java-boro.notes: Buddhist architecture, 8th–9th-century chronology, Sailendra connections and reliefs; architecture cannot reconstruct all labor or village life.

g2-java-pram.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Prambanan Temple Compounds
g2-java-pram.notes: Hindu and Buddhist temple complexes and dates in central Java; religious labels do not map every household.

g2-java-sima.title: Miho Yamasaki, The Reign and the Royal Authority in King Balitung’s Period: Old Javanese Inscriptions (2015)
g2-java-sima.notes: Named sima land/tax grants connecting kings, officials and religious foundations; source is abstract for article.

g2-java-maj.title: UNESCO Tentative List, Trowulan: Former Capital City of Majapahit Kingdom (Indonesian nomination)
g2-java-maj.notes: Archaeological objects and settlement traces at Trowulan; state-party heritage nomination includes hypotheses and advocacy claims.

g2-java-poem.title: The Galactic Polity in Southeast Asia, with discussion of fourteenth-century Majapahit and Nagarakretagama (HAU, 2013)
g2-java-poem.notes: Interpretive analysis of Prapanca’s court poem and uneven political reach; abstract/excerpt not evidence of direct rule over listed areas.

g2-tur-berlin.title: Simone-Christiane Raschmann, The Berlin Turfan Collection (Berlin State Library)
g2-tur-berlin.notes: Scripts, languages, texts, collecting history and problems of cyclical dates; curator synthesis not a translation of an individual contract.

g2-tur-bbaw.title: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy, Turfanforschung / Turfan Studies
g2-tur-bbaw.notes: Current edition and cataloguing of religious, commercial, monastic and letter texts in numerous languages; collection summary.

g2-tur-books.title: University of Hamburg, Reconstructing Old Uyghur Book Forms (2023–25)
g2-tur-books.notes: Fragment-based reconstruction and book forms; not a survey of all oasis households.

g2-tur-script.title: Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin, Berlin Turfan Collection: secular and religious manuscripts
g2-tur-script.notes: Old Uyghur texts, Sogdian-derived script, economic fragments and 12-year animal calendar dating; fragmentary records limit precision.

g2-tur-museum.title: Museum für Asiatische Kunst, The Turfan Collection and Expeditions
g2-tur-museum.notes: 1902–1914 collecting history, archival records and provenance; modern institutional perspective, not medieval political history.

g2-tur-forms.title: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy, Turfan Studies manuscript catalogues
g2-tur-forms.notes: Editing of Uyghur economic texts, manuscripts, block prints and multilingual material; a cataloguing overview.

g3-mv-ua.title: University of Alabama Museums, Moundville Archaeological Park, Ancient Site
g3-mv-ua.notes: Black Warrior setting, phased occupancy, plaza, palisade, mounds, ceremonial transformation; museum synthesis of archaeological research.

g3-mv-blitz.title: John H. Blitz, Moundville in the Mississippian World, Oxford Handbook of North American Archaeology (2012)
g3-mv-blitz.notes: Specialist four-phase occupation chronology and social-memory interpretation; only abstract publicly reviewed.

g3-mv-ency.title: Vernon James Knight and Encyclopedia of Alabama, Moundville Archaeological Park
g3-mv-ency.notes: Settlement, maize, occupations, construction, burials and shifting population; estimates and elite interpretations are reconstructive.

g3-mv-tribal.title: Moundville Archaeological Park, Self Guided Tour (2026), prepared with descendant Tribal communities
g3-mv-tribal.notes: Names living Tribal Nations, distinguishes archaeological label from community identity, describes material culture and changing burial role; official descendant-collaborative interpretation, not exact lineage census.

g3-mv-exhibit.title: Moundville Archaeological Park, The Home of Our Ancestors exhibit co-curated by Jake Tiger (2026)
g3-mv-exhibit.notes: Current Seminole co-curation and continuities of craft and culture; not independent proof of individual ancient genealogies.

g3-pl-npspeople.title: National Park Service, Knife River People
g3-pl-npspeople.notes: Upper Missouri riverine farming, bison hunting, earthlodges and oral accounts; many described villages are post-1500, so avoid unqualified projection.

g3-pl-npsplaces.title: National Park Service, Places at Knife River Indian Villages
g3-pl-npsplaces.notes: Geography, Hidatsa farm labor, earthlodge village traces and historic livelihoods; contact-era evidence cannot establish all prehistoric practices.

g3-pl-npsarticle.title: National Park Service, Knife River Indian Villages National Historic Site
g3-pl-npsarticle.notes: Village chronology and later Mandan/Hidatsa/Arikara history, including main Knife River site dates after 1525; careful pre-1500 scope required.

g3-pl-middle.title: US National Park Service National Register, Bison Kill Sites in South Dakota thematic context, Middle Missouri archaeology
g3-pl-middle.notes: Archaeological context for Middle Missouri houses, village layout, mixed horticulture and hunting from AD 900 onward; regional synthesis and interpretive assignments.

g3-pl-education.title: National Park Service, Knife River: Early Village Life on the Plains
g3-pl-education.notes: Earthlodge engineering and documented Mandan/Hidatsa/Arikara households, later-era descriptions that must not be assumed unchanged for year 1000.

g3-arctic-sirm.title: Parks Canada, Sirmilik National Park: History
g3-arctic-sirm.notes: Eastern Arctic Dorset and Thule occupation, house construction, hunting and mobility; Indigenous descent and uncertainty of interactions.

g3-arctic-ivv.title: Parks Canada, Ivvavik National Park: Culture and history
g3-arctic-ivv.notes: Beaufort Sea settlement and subsequent regional adaptation, including thirteenth-century developments; park-region specificity.

g3-arctic-tuktut.title: Parks Canada, Tuktut Nogait: Culture and history
g3-arctic-tuktut.notes: Regional archaeological site distribution and c. 1200–1500 occupation, not a general chronology for entire Arctic.

g3-arctic-review.title: Arctic Archaeology and Climate Change, Annual Review of Anthropology (2019)
g3-arctic-review.notes: Scholarly review of dispersal, subsistence variability, whales, exchange and climate responses; long-term synthesis with regional uncertainty.

g3-arctic-qutt.title: Parks Canada, Quttinirpaaq Management Plan: Arctic archaeological sequence
g3-arctic-qutt.notes: High Arctic archaeological evidence and Inuit heritage technologies, site variation and preservation.

g3-et-unesco.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Rock-Hewn Churches, Lalibela
g3-et-unesco.notes: Architecture, sacred geography, related town remains and conservation; royal foundation narrative is heritage tradition not independent construction dating.

g3-et-rock.title: The rock-cut churches of Lalibela and cave church of Washa Mikael, Antiquity 95 (2021)
g3-et-rock.notes: Specialist archaeological evidence of earlier troglodytic cultures and stages of Christianization; public abstract, not full field data.

g3-et-lund.title: Lund University, The Church of Yimrhane Kristos: An Archaeological Investigation (2018)
g3-et-lund.notes: Archaeometry, wood analysis, inscriptions and qualified use of hagiographic evidence; public research summary.

g3-et-settlement.title: Settlement archaeology and oral history in Lasta, Ethiopia (2009)
g3-et-settlement.notes: Lalibela settlement context beyond churches and oral-history approaches; public abstract only.

g3-et-land.title: Administrative and military impediments of medieval Ethiopian economy, Cogent Arts & Humanities (2023)
g3-et-land.notes: Discussion of gwelt, revenue claims and medieval Ethiopian officials; predominantly later medieval systems, avoid back-projection.

g3-geniza-pgp.title: Princeton Geniza Project, Digital Corpus and introduction
g3-geniza-pgp.notes: Institutional history, letters, contracts, catalog and translations; corpus reflects documented Jewish communities, not population-wide sample.

g3-geniza-court.title: Princeton Geniza Project, Legal document T-S 12.558
g3-geniza-court.notes: Cairo 1180s court notebook and half-house arrangement involving Sitt al-Fakhr; editorial description based on Goitein and Amir Ashur.

g3-geniza-letter.title: Princeton Geniza Project, Letter T-S 10J15.9, including edited translation
g3-geniza-letter.notes: Woman to absent husband, illness, family dispute, possible divorce; fragmentary text and contested reconstructions.

g3-geniza-goldberg.title: Jessica L. Goldberg, The use and abuse of commercial letters from the Cairo Geniza, Journal of Medieval History (2012)
g3-geniza-goldberg.notes: Commercial letter genres, business networks and why requests are not neutral transaction reports.

g3-geniza-krak.title: Eve Krakowski, Coming of Age in Medieval Egypt, Princeton University Press (2018)
g3-geniza-krak.notes: Study of Fatimid and Ayyubid Jewish girls, wealth, legal practice and household diversity; book description reviewed, not full text.

g3-geniza-rustow.title: Princeton University, Marina Rustow and the Cairo Geniza: Fragile Fragments (2019)
g3-geniza-rustow.notes: Geniza discovery, storage and dispersion, documents and public-administration research; institutional reporting on scholarly work.

g3-geniza-women.title: Posen Library, Letter to Her Sister, early twelfth century
g3-geniza-women.notes: Describes female author/scribe, family, guardianship and inheritance; publicly reviewed editorial summary rather than full restricted text.

g3-dvar-oxford.title: Wesley Clarke and Matthew Gallon, Early States in Thailand: Dvaravati, Oxford Handbook of Early Southeast Asia (2022)
g3-dvar-oxford.notes: Sixth–eleventh-century archaeology, uncertain polity form, poorly documented domestic sites, limitations of monument-centered research; abstract only.

g3-dvar-met.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art, Lost Kingdoms exhibition: Dvaravati Buddhist art (2014)
g3-dvar-met.notes: Sculpture, monumental images, wheels and narrative reliefs; museum art history does not demonstrate state boundaries.

g3-dvar-chron.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art, Southeast Asia 500–1000 CE Chronology
g3-dvar-chron.notes: Regional chronology, Dvaravati, Mon and trade connections; overview with simplifications about statehood.

g3-dvar-inscr.title: East and West: New Inscriptions from Funan, Zhenla and Dvaravati, BEFEO (2021)
g3-dvar-inscr.notes: New Nakhon Pathom Sanskrit epigraphy and paleographic date uncertainty; local elite claims not polity-wide map.

g3-dvar-trade.title: The International Trade in Dvaravati Period: Archaeology of Nakhon Pathom, Silpakorn University Journal (2013)
g3-dvar-trade.notes: Excavated Tang pottery and nonlocal beads, contacts and trade; site-specific interpretation from abstract.

g3-dvar-smith.title: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art, Dvaravati period stucco objects
g3-dvar-smith.notes: Khu Bua and related sculpture chronology and provenance; art objects cannot establish household demographics.

g3-cham-unesco.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, My Son Sanctuary
g3-cham-unesco.notes: Thu Bon valley landscape, My Son temple forms and sanctuary chronology; heritage account tends to present a singular Cham kingdom.

g3-cham-oxford.title: William A. Southworth, Champa, Oxford Handbook of Early Southeast Asia (2022)
g3-cham-oxford.notes: Tra Kieu, Go Cam, Han China, Sanskrit and Cham inscriptions, poor domestic ceramic dating; specialist abstract only.

g3-cham-dissert.title: My Ket Chau, Communities and Cultural Exchanges of Champa: Art of the Chams in Central and Southern Vietnam, UCLA (2020)
g3-cham-dissert.notes: Networked ritual arts, four pedestal-shrines, mixed interpretations, maritime links; dissertation abstract publicly reviewed.

g3-cham-polity.title: Mai Bui Dieu Linh, Religious Identity and Contemporary Ritual Practices of the Cham Ahier in Vietnam, Extreme-Orient Extreme-Occident 45 (2022; online 2025)
g3-cham-polity.notes: The article discusses river-valley versus five-principality models of Champa and cites the competing argument from fifteenth-century epigraphy for a more extensive kingdom; this is a review of the debate in a study primarily of present-day Cham Ahier practice.

g3-dun-history.title: International Dunhuang Programme, History of the IDP and Cave 17
g3-dun-history.notes: Sealing, discovery, dispersion of Cave 17 materials; institutional history of collections.

g3-dun-languages.title: International Dunhuang Programme, What Was Stored in Cave 17?
g3-dun-languages.notes: Languages, religious texts, documents, Old Tibetan Annals and cave contents; collection-level profile.

g3-dun-timeline.title: International Dunhuang Programme, A Timeline of Dunhuang
g3-dun-timeline.notes: Tibetan rule approximately 781–848 and local Guiyijun regime; overview chronology.

g3-dun-work.title: International Dunhuang Programme, Dunhuang at Work
g3-dun-work.notes: Census, irrigation, taxes, local administration and diplomatic responsibilities under Guiyijun; general archive synthesis.

g3-dun-scribes.title: International Dunhuang Programme, Scribes at Dunhuang: Pens, Paper and Punishments (2025)
g3-dun-scribes.notes: Named IOL Tib J 1359 scribal-paper register and IOL Tib J 1274 Ser Dzinkheng wrapper; records threats, not measured enforcement.

g3-dun-circular.title: International Dunhuang Programme, Entertainment and Social Life
g3-dun-circular.notes: 886 circular for meeting, fines, signatures and other local associations; translated summary of original document.

g3-dun-guangde.title: International Dunhuang Programme, Daily Life Collection Items, contract of 916
g3-dun-guangde.notes: Contract recording transfer of seven-year-old Guangde by mother A Wu, coercion and reused scroll; cannot establish the child’s later fate.

g3-dun-taenzer.title: Gertraud Taenzer, The Dunhuang Region during Tibetan Rule (787–848): A Study of Secular Manuscripts, Harrassowitz (2012)
g3-dun-taenzer.notes: Chinese and Tibetan tax records, land, contracts and mixed administrative practice; part of scholarly book accessible in JSTOR text preview.
